title: Resultado de una carga
brief: Result screen of a LogiSur to Expreso Andino upload run, for non-technical operations staff: answer '¿Tengo que hacer algo?' first, then what to fix and where, successes collapsed, technical detail behind 'Ver detalle técnico'. Real kit data.

artboards.title: La nota
artboards.tradeoff: Reads like a short note from a colleague: calm and personal, fixes written as sentences; scans worse when there are many pending items

artboards.title: La bandeja
artboards.tradeoff: A worklist with list and detail, step-by-step fixes and 'Ya lo corregí' checks; scales to many items and has room for Atrasados, but it is the most app-like and has the most chrome

artboards.title: El mapa
artboards.tradeoff: One tile per shipment shows the whole batch at a glance and the same tiles fill in during the upload; the successes stay visible (quiet), motion only on demand (live replay of the run, selection, disclosures), and past a few hundred shipments the map needs grouping
